title: PicardAffineTargetNormalization
statement: Let f:X→S be flat proper locally finitely presented with universally isomorphic structure adjunction units. Fix derived-category instances for every scheme and localized open. Let M be an O_X-module, k:W→S any morphism, and U an affine open of W such that the pullback of M to X×S U is trivial. Then the restriction to U of R(f_W)_*(M_W[0]) is represented by a strictly perfect complex C on the localized module site over U with all negative terms zero and differential C^0→C^1 zero. The affine U is supplied and is not shrunk. The notions are [def-pc-perfect-complex], [def-pc-derived-direct-image], [def-pc-module-pullback], [def-weil-flat-morphism], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction].

source.place: Tag 0BF2, proof before the joint H-one injectivity argument; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BF2

proof.text: Use the trivialization and open base-change compatibility to identify the restricted image with R(f_U)_*O. Perfect base change makes it perfect and universally connective. Transfer to modules on the affine and obtain a bounded finite projective representative.

Cancel negative terms successively. At the lowest term fibre connectiveness makes the differential injective on every residue field. Mathlib IsLocalRing.split_injective_iff_lTensor_residueField_injective gives a local splitting with locally free cokernel. The finitely presented cokernel is therefore finite projective on the affine; split it globally and cancel the contractible pair. Repeat finitely many times.

Represent the derived structure unit by a chain map. Universal H-zero comparison makes its cycle unimodular. Split off its unit summand, then apply the same residue split-injection criterion to the remaining degree-zero summand and cancel its contractible pair. Sheafify to obtain C and the derived isomorphism. The empty affine gives the zero complex.

lean.statement: theorem picard_affine_target_normalization [∀ Y : Scheme.{v}, HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] [∀ (Y : Scheme.{v}) (U : Y.Opens), HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over U))] {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (g : T ⟶ S), IsIso ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g))).unit.app (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf))) (M : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) (U : W.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (htrivial : Nonempty ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (U.ι ≫ k))).obj M ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (pullback f (U.ι ≫ k)).ringCatSheaf)) : ∃ C : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{v} ((moduleRings W.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ, IsStrictlyPerfect W U C ∧ (∀ j : ℤ, j < 0 → IsZero (C.X j)) ∧ C.d 0 1 = 0 ∧ Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{v} (moduleRings W.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj M))) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)
